text.en: A member elected on a party's ticket leaves it and joins another
A person who was never elected leaves one party for another party
A party in power changes a policy it announced before the polling
A voter who backed one party chooses a different party the next time

explanation.en: Defection needs a person elected on a party's ticket who then leaves it or acts against it. Anyone else can change parties freely. A party changing a policy, or a voter changing their mind, is not defection.

hints.en: Find the person who was elected on a party's ticket.
